scope.purpose: Govern stable family identity while keeping dynamic variation in type/instance data.

requirements.statement: Family names shall be unique, stable, human-readable, semantically meaningful, and discoverable.
The conceptual family naming pattern shall distinguish discipline/domain, native category/system, type/function, and optional variant/classification/descriptor.
Dynamic physical states, ratings, sizes, and other governed variation shall not be endlessly encoded into the family name where type or parameter data is the appropriate carrier.

provenance.migration_note: L4 family-naming micro-standard retained separately from L6 tool instructions; competing Appendix E details remain migration evidence pending S4 curator decisions.
